description: Structured reads of central-bank and multilateral publications: decisions, stance (-2 dovish to +2 hawkish), guidance, conditions, speaker and forecasts, each with a link to the original. Newest first; pages via offset / next_offset.

limit.description: Items per page, at most 100. Default 40.

offset.description: Skip this many items; pass the previous response's next_offset to read the next page.

provider_id.description: A central bank or multilateral (id from list_providers). Matches the publisher or the institution whose view it is.

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ago. The free plan reaches back 7 days for individual items.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today.

name: get_policy_signals
title: Get central bank and policy-maker signals
